newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clinton arrives in Paris for NATO signing.
newsitem.headline: Clinton arrives in Paris for NATO signing.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton arrived in Paris on Tuesday for the signing of a landmark pact between Moscow and NATO intended to open the way to an eastward expansion of the Atlantic alliance.
Clinton's jet landed at Orly airport south of the capital for the ceremony (0830 GMT) at France's grandiose Elysee Palace. Russian President Boris Yeltsin arrived in Paris on Monday.

Clinton arrived with his wife Hillary Rodham Clinton, who was to fly on for a visit to the Netherlands. White House press secretary Mike McCurry said that the couple "rested comfortably" during the flight.
